summary: ObjectGenome's documented deterministic validation-report contract is not source-locked: several issue-producing paths traverse hash maps with pairs(), so semantically identical malformed data can expose table-layout-dependent issue ordering and ObjectGenome.validate() concatenates that order into its assertion text. Canonicalize diagnostic traversal/order or sort issues before publication, and add a regression that compares the full ordered report for equivalent invalid inputs built with different table construction histories.
evidence: Docs/OBJECT_GENOME.md promises ObjectGenome.inspect(genome) returns a structured deterministic report and says issue codes are suitable for procedural rejection/repro tooling.
src/shared/Objects/ObjectGenome.luau validateRecordShape emits schema.unknown_field issues directly from pairs(value).

src/shared/Objects/ObjectGenome.luau starts support-cycle traversal with for componentKey in pairs(componentsByKey), and ObjectState missing-key validation iterates knownKeys/componentKeys with pairs().
src/shared/Objects/ObjectGenome.luau formatIssues preserves the report array order when ObjectGenome.validate() builds its observable assertion message.
